meta.parties: Parasatty Ammah Et Al. v. Setupulle

rules.statement: A donation is not void because the donor exercised his liberality and munificence under the influence of affection, whether of creditable affection or of discreditable affection.
rules.supporting_quote: "Affectionis gratia neque honestce, neque inhonestm donationes sunt. prohibitce; honestce erga bent merentes amicos vel necessarios inhonestce circa meretrices " (Digest, XXXIX., tit. 5, section 5)."
